home.welcome_text: Welcome to {{SITE_NAME}}, your ultimate destination for easy high-protein snack recipes. From no-bake protein bites to creamy cottage cheese bowls, we've got tasty, healthy ideas for every craving and every macro goal.

about.hero_subtitle: Easy snack recipes designed to fuel your day with real protein
about.explore_intro: {{SITE_NAME}} offers a curated collection of snack recipes designed for every taste and event. From quick bites to party platters, our site helps you find the perfect snack inspiration anytime.

explore_items.text: A wide variety of snack recipes from sweet to savory.
Recipes suitable for beginners and seasoned cooks alike.
Occasion-specific ideas for parties, casual snacking, and holidays.
Regular updates with trending and classic snack recipes.

about.founder_intro: I'm passionate about sharing easy, high-protein snack recipes that taste amazing and fuel your goals. My mission is to prove that healthy snacking doesn't have to be boring, complicated, or expensive — it just has to be delicious and packed with real protein.

founder_items.text: All recipes are tested to ensure easy and reliable results.
Ingredients are chosen for accessibility and flavor.
Clear instructions to make cooking approachable for everyone.
A focus on diverse snack types to suit different preferences.

about.goals_intro: Here are the core goals driving {{SITE_NAME}}’s mission to delight snack lovers everywhere.

goals_items.text: Inspire creativity in home cooking and entertaining.
Build a friendly community for sharing snack ideas.
Offer reliable content suitable for all skill levels.

about.selection_intro: Content on {{SITE_NAME}} is selected based on quality, reliability, and user value to ensure the best snacking experience.

selection_items.text: Recipes are tested for consistency and taste.
Instructions are clear and easy to follow.
Ingredients are accessible to most home cooks.
Variety is prioritized to cover diverse snack preferences.
Content is updated regularly to reflect new trends and classics.

about.connect_text: We love hearing from fellow snack enthusiasts! Feel free to reach out with questions, suggestions, or just to say hello.

contact.hero_subtitle: Get in Touch with Your High-Protein Snack Experts
contact.intro: Have questions, feedback, or a high-protein snack recipe you'd love to see? We're here to help! Whether you need a substitution tip, want to share your meal-prep wins, or have a partnership inquiry, reach out anytime at contact@{{SITE_HOST}}. We read every message and will get back to you as soon as possible — usually within 24-48 hours.

faq.q: Can I submit my own snack recipe to {{SITE_NAME}}?
faq.a: Currently, we focus on curated recipes selected by our team, but we welcome suggestions via email for future consideration.

faq.q: How often do you add new snack recipes?
faq.a: We regularly update {{SITE_NAME}} with fresh recipes every week to keep your snack options exciting.

faq.q: Can recipes be customized for dietary restrictions?
faq.a: Many of our recipes include tips for substitutions to suit common dietary needs; please check each recipe's notes section.

faq.q: Is there a way to request a specific type of snack recipe?
faq.a: Yes, you can send your recipe requests to contact@{{SITE_HOST}}, and we’ll do our best to feature them.

privacy.hero_subtitle: Protecting your privacy with no personal data collected unnecessarily
privacy.welcome_text: At {{SITE_NAME}}, your privacy is our top priority. We're committed to protecting your personal information while delivering the best high-protein snack recipes and healthy snacking inspiration. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our site or interact with our content.
privacy.welcome_text2: We use trusted third-party services to enhance site functionality but do not collect or share personal data without your consent at {{SITE_HOST}}.
privacy.conclusion_text: Thank you for trusting {{SITE_NAME}} as your go-to destination for high-protein snack recipes. We value your privacy and are dedicated to delivering quality, healthy, and protein-packed content you can rely on. If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy, feel free to contact us anytime — we're here to help.
